note: One place at the match: who holds it, what they brought, and what the client shows for them.

fields.name: player
fields.note: Which player holds the place, or a negative number where it stands empty. It has a player identifier's width. In every capture its values equal the seat numbers, because the stand-in players there are numbered the same way, so the values alone do not tell the two apart.

fields.name: level
fields.note: The level the seat holder has reached across matches. A 4.17 client does not draw it on the loading screen.

fields.name: summoner
fields.note: The spell in one of the seat's summoner slots, as the name hash of the spell; drawn as its icon on the loading screen. A bot's seat leaves it unread.

fields.name: flags
fields.note: How the seat is treated. A 4.17 client reads two bits: bit 0, set where a bot holds the seat, which the loading screen then shows from the bot fields below as already loaded; and bit 1, set to show the seat's champion on the loading screen in its skin's vintage art. It reads none of the others.

fields.name: side
fields.note: The side the seat is on, or zero where it stands empty.

fields.name: botName
fields.note: What the seat is called where nobody holds it, written and padded as above. A 4.17 client shows its own name for a bot of the champion instead.

fields.name: botAsset
fields.note: The name the client loads art for it under where nobody holds it, written and padded as above.

fields.name: standing
fields.note: What the seat's standing across matches is called, written and padded as above. A 4.17 client frames the seat's loading-screen card with its own image of that name, where it has one; UNRANKED and BRONZE draw nothing.

fields.name: botSkin
fields.note: Which look it wears where nobody holds it.

fields.name: botDifficulty
fields.note: How well it plays where nobody holds it: 0 beginner, 1 intermediate, 2 advanced, 3 top, 4 tutorial, 5 intro. A 4.17 client draws it nowhere and picks the bot's summoner spells by it.

fields.name: icon
fields.note: Which profile icon the client shows on the seat's loading-screen card; a negative number, or one with no art, shows icon 0's.

fields.name: allyBadge
fields.note: The badge a 4.17 client shows on the seat's card to the seat's own side (and to a client on neither side), where it is one of the badges the client's own data names.

fields.name: enemyBadge
fields.note: The badge it shows where the ally badge is not shown and this is nonzero.
